reason: A runtime utility that scans tool results for indirect prompt-injection patterns and can warn or quarantine suspicious content before it reaches model context.

summaries.zh: 在工具结果进入模型上下文前检测间接提示注入，并根据配置记录警告或隔离可疑内容。
summaries.en: Detects indirect prompt-injection patterns in tool results before they enter model context and can warn or quarantine suspicious content according to configuration.

capabilities: Scans text returned by web, MCP, browser, shell, file, and other tools
Detects prompt-injection patterns using deterministic English and Chinese rules
Can observe findings, prepend warnings, or replace tool results with quarantine errors
Can prevent blocked raw tool results from entering model context
Produces rule IDs, scores, and SHA-256-derived fingerprints without logging matched text
